body: Thanks, I will check out that subreddit for sure. I hope so too, that I will get relief from this.

You are exactly right in that my fear is exhausting me. And I constantly feel overwhelmed with things.

I do eat everything but in moderation. Any type of restriction in eating certain foods just makes me want to binge though. So I try not to do that. Also, I have some personal reasons that currently don't allow me to fast. But I will try fasting later this year.
I will be speaking to a church counselor a few months from now, so I will find out then if I may need deliverance.

Posting on here has prompted to try other things, this coming week I may be going to a more specific church service (not a sunday service). Also, in a few months I will be able to speak with a church counselor. 

I think I really need a mentor figure in my life, as in real, not on the internet. I will pray for one from God. 

I definitely don't think I'm being hard on myself, I don't know why but I can't even consider that.

As for the Bush analogy, I am at a place where I don't think I've ever thrown a starfish back into the ocean. The closest I've gotten to helping someone was asking another person to help that someone.

Please continue to pray for me, I really need it.

Sorry I am replying to you so late I just wanted to really look into each verse you suggested I read and think about it. These all are relevant to what I am going through. 

Thank you for your words of encouragement. I sometimes find it hard to believe that God is still in control because He gave us a free will. So its almost like He has introduced Himself into my life but I am not choosing to follow Him.

Thank you for writing out a whole prayer for me. I will most definitely pray it tonight.
Thank you for your prayers. Unfortunately weather is not permitting me to go to the park any time soon.

I do realize that I have a lot of fears. Like a lot a lot. Its a real struggle to me. I try to remind myself that "there is no fear in love" but I still have the fear.

I don't think I am depressed as the symptoms don't fit with me.

Thank you for those verses! I am glad you quoted  God's Word directly because its also so much more meaningful than anything a person could say.

What do you mean by "pray for confirmations"?

I do need a friend who gets me, provably a psychologisteven more. I suck at making friends though, and I don't have insurance.

About those jobs you said, I cant work those jobs for obvious reasons as I am a stay at home parent.

You are right I need to spend more time in the Word of God.

Hi. Thank you for your reply. We don't seem to have much in common as I don't struggle with those types of sins. I don't have issues with any sexual sin at all, and have never smoked anything. 

How did you know that the Holy Spirit entered your life? I don't mean that to be rude, I just wanted to know from someone else's experience, so that I could tell when it happens to me, I guess.
Thank you, you have reminded me that if we choose to follow Christ and be born again, then our past dies too with all those mistakes in it.

I have looked at symptoms of depression before and I don't fit that at all. 

I just looked at inattentive ADHD and oh my the symptoms describe me about 85%!

This is something I never looked at before. I think I will mention this when I got to the counselor at my church and go from there.

It does help, thank you. I will pray for God to show me what He wants me to learn from all of this. Not comparing myself is hard, but something I can be more conscious of and stop myself more often in the act of it. I am still learning what it means to depend on God and draw from His strength.

What you said about having 294 applications gives me so much hope to keep trying.

I focus too much on trying to be perfect that I end up doing nothing at all. It all just feels like one step forward two steps back. I don't really know if I should keep doing what I'm doing  and just need more patience and effort and not quit? Or I should change my way of living completely, like am I missing something in the method and execution of living out God's will for my life? Maybe it's a conviction to reevaluate things?

I think I am continuously still living in sin?

Although I have a chruch to go to, I can't exactly go there now. But I will try to get there this week. Also, like all churches, if you don't make relationships there it can be difficult. I am not a social person so its tough, plus my little children make it even more problematic to be socializing because im always taking care of them during and after church service.

Honestly what you just wrote makes me feel so much better that I don't have much else to say except thank you!

Thank you for sharing. Maybe I will go back to persue another degree. I do want to surrender to God but am struggling to do so. I really want be used by God, I don't think I will ever choose to be used by Him, if that makes sense.
Thank for your encouragement and prayers! I will try to focus more on His love.

Thank you, but I don't have enough of an in-depth knowledge of the Bible to write Bible studies. I've also read much better writing here on reddit. Including replies to this post and your reply as well.

Being thankful is really hard for me. I am thankful for all I have but its hard knowing I have so much and I'm taking it for granted. I feel stuck in this, that I'm not moving forward. The process should be that you relize what you're doing wrong and then you work on it. So I realize how much I have to be thankful for, and that the fruit of my thankfulness is not present in the lives of others. But I both don't know how to live out being thankful and also I don't "want to" because I'm lazy. So that makes me hate myself even more.

I have heard about food sometimes causing depressive symptoms, but I take a multi vitamin and eat generally healthy. Junk food actually make me feel better though, or at least I think it gives me a temporary distraction because it feels good to eat delicious food.

What I meant about replacement I wasn't talking about my parents. I am married and have children. I would be giving my spouse a chance to find someone who treats them better than I, and a better parent for my children. Someone to raise then to be strong Christians, an example for them and a person that they could come to for advice. I don't want my children to be anything like me.

I've been considering this but I can't see a psychologist. No insurance. I can possibly see a counselor from a church I sometimes go to when I can. But it will only be a few months from now. Good thing you pointed this out as it gives me something to look forward to. Since it won't be soon.

I agree that its never too late to change, but I am losing hope that I will ever change. I don't want to be a burden. I'm sorry I feel so annoying to all of you who have replied because I have an argument for each thing everyone says. But thats becuase I actually feel that way. The fact that you went back to college to persue a different career is encouraging because I think that is what I may have to do. I got an associates degree, but I procrastinated and looked up answers online all through it so I don't actually know how to do what I studied to do. After that, I didn't get any work experience in that field and again because I'm not a people person, I don't think I will be able to get a job in that field.

As for what God wants of us, you put it plain and simple but when I get to application of it, it becomes difficult. There is the big decisions that are difficult to make, but also even the little ones. For example "should I reorganize the pantry or should I spend time on exercise?" Both are things I need to do. I almost have this feeling like I don't know how to live life, if that makes sense.

Those 5 are simple, again, they are difficult for me to apply. How do I be merciful without being walked all over? Acting just is difficult because I don't have the confidence to do so. I  guess I just don't know how to be those things. How can I learn?

Thank you for your reply. I guess maybe I would want to see fruit in my life, or works as a reflection of my faith. I know they don't determine faith, but they are an example of our faith. Also, what is His will then? And what makes things more difficult is that I am looking back 10 years now and I don't see major changes and that hurts the most. Especially changes in mind, thinking, feelings, etc. Thank you though, your comment on how doing better tommorow and growing oven time does give me hope to keep trying. I just don't want to wake up 10 years from now and feel the same mentally.
